subject: Pilot performance & capacity ask — Pinegrove competitive evaluation
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@pinegrove.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick question on pilot throughput claims

Hi Ben / Marissa,

We kicked off internal review of the pilot results VergeAI sent over and have a few follow-ups before procurement signs off. Their slide says they can sustain 350 qps for our 1.2k context workload with 98th p99 latency under 400ms — that conflicts with what we observed in our load tests.

Can Redwood run a targeted bench for the same model+prompt set (we'll share the prompt bundle) and demonstrate sustained 10k daily concurrency with a short warm-up? Procurement also wants an ask on a short-term uplift plan for capacity and an SLA addendum if we move to Dedicated.

Liam
Head of AI Platform
Pinegrove Retail

---
Attachment: pinegrove_prompt_bundle_v1.zip (attachment referenced)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@pinegrove.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question on pilot throughput claims

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and the prompt bundle. We can absolutely run a like-for-like throughput benchmark and compare the metrics you flagged.

Proposed immediate actions: 
- Redwood runs a 72-hour benchmark using your prompt set and the same model family (we'll replicate context length and batching).
- Provide a side-by-side report (throughput, p50/p95/p99 latencies, token cost) and recorded traces for a subset of the run.
- Offer a one-time 30-day Dedicated uplift (reserved nodes) and a short SLA rider covering p95 latency and capacity floor while you run production validation.

I'll loop in Rishi to scope the benchmark and Marissa for approval on the uplift terms. Expect a draft MAP and pilot config by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0124

Cc: procurement@pinegrove.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question on pilot throughput claims

Thanks Ben — that sounds good. A couple of clarifications from procurement:
- Can the uplift be guaranteed for 30 days with an option to convert to an annual reserved commitment?
- We'll need an audit trail for token usage and a log export for our compliance team (SOC2 scope).
- VergeAI has offered a 20% service credit if they miss throughput targets; we'd like to see an equivalent or better commitment from Redwood for the pilot window.

If you can send an annotated MAP showing the uplift nodes, expected token burn, and the SLA rider we're happy to get procurement to sign quickly.

Liam

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Bench plan + config for Pinegrove pilot

Ben / Marissa — I've scoped the bench. Key points: 
- We'll run the bench on a Dedicated cluster matching Pinegrove's requested model family with mixed precision and quantization profile Q4_1 where appropriate.
- Test phases: cold-start ramp (12h), steady-state throughput (48h), failover/latency spike injection (12h).
- Deliverables: CSV traces, aggregate latency histograms, flamegraphs for hot kernels, and a token-usage log (per-request).

I attached the pilot config and the minimal runbook. Pricing note: the 30-day uplift will require us to reserve 6 x A100-equivalent slots for the window; estimated blended uplift cost is in the draft quote. If procurement needs an SLA credit schedule, legal prefers an objective metric (p95 > X ms triggers credit).

Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Team — approve the bench and uplift as outlined. A couple of guardrails: 
- Offer a one-time 20% uplift discount on the 30-day dedicated uplift (to match VergeAI's publicized credit level) but only if Pinegrove signs the pilot SOW within 5 business days.
- Include token-level export and a weekly audit dump to Pinegrove's S3 bucket; legal will add SOC2 audit language to the rider.
- For SLA credits, cap at 15% of the uplift fee and set clear p95 thresholds (we'll align with Rishi on the exact ms numbers).

Ben — please prepare the redwood_custom_quote.pdf and the MAP with the uplift nodes and docuSign link. Push to HubSpot deal PG-2026-0042.

Marissa

Hi Liam / procurement team — attaching the pilot MAP and formal quote for the 30-day Dedicated uplift we discussed. Summary highlights: 
- 30-day Dedicated uplift: 6 reserved GPUs, expected sustained throughput target 300–360 qps for your workload after warm-up.
- SLA rider: p95 latency guarantee with a credit schedule capped at 15% of uplift fee if thresholds are missed.
- Compliance: daily token export CSV and weekly audit dump to your S3 (SOC2-friendly format).
- Conversion option: 30-day uplift converts to 12-month reserved capacity with a 12% conversion credit off the uplift price if signed within 10 business days.

Links: 
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/PG-2026-0042
- DocuSign (SOW + rider): https://www.docusign.com/seed/PG-2026-0042

Attachments: redwood_custom_quote.pdf, pinegrove_map_v1.pdf, pinegrove_pilot_config.yml

Looking forward to getting this scheduled — if you want, we can start the bench next Monday and share interim traces after 24 hours.

Best,
Ben Carter

1) Can you add a pre-termination clause specific to the uplift period allowing us to exit with pro-rated fees if production fails to meet a sustained 250 qps over a 48-hour steady-state window?
2) Provide a short runbook for how Redwood will validate and hand off logs to our compliance team (we need the exact CSV columns and S3 lifecycle policy).

If you can add those two items to the SOW page in DocuSign we'll route for signature.

Procurement
Pinegrove Retail
